verdict.rationale: Mastra's own observability claims to show every model call, tool call and handoff in one searchable timeline, and tracks tool usage across every production agent run, which covers the core of a tool-call log. Captured traces can feed versioned datasets for repeatable evaluation, but that is evaluation, not documented replay. The evidence is landing-page level and does not show the per-call detail needed for auditing. missing for 10: documented per-call detail (arguments, outputs, identities) sufficient for audit, an explicit replay capability, audit-log retention or export, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did

citations.quote: Inspect every model call, tool call, and handoff from one searchable timeline.
Track latency, cost, model calls, and tool usage across every production agent run.
Capture traces and user feedback into versioned datasets for repeatable evaluation.
